videos.title: Seasons | The Earth-sun-moon system | Middle school Earth and space science
videos.matches: It covers how the tilted Earth going round the Sun makes the seasons, the core idea of the lesson.

videos.title: Conductors and Insulators | Electricity | Telangana Grade-7 Physics
videos.matches: It explains which materials let electricity through and which hold it back, the lesson's main question.

videos.title: Conservation of energy | Middle school physics
videos.matches: It shows energy passing between forms and staying in total, as the marble's energy does in the lesson.

videos.title: Potential energy | Middle school physics
videos.matches: It explains stored energy from height and how it turns into movement, as in the rolling marble.

videos.title: Orbital motion | Earth and space science
videos.matches: It explains an orbit as a fall that keeps missing the ground, using the Earth and Moon.

videos.title: Gravity for astronauts in orbit | Centripetal force and gravitation | Physics
videos.matches: It explains why astronauts in orbit feel weightless even though gravity still pulls on them.

videos.title: Orbital Velocity | Space missions | MH Grade 10 | Science
videos.matches: It explains the speed a satellite needs to keep orbiting, which the lesson's satellites depend on.

videos.title: The Scientific Method | Wonderful World of Science | Middle School | Science
videos.matches: It shows how a question, a test and a fair comparison lead to a conclusion that others can check.

videos.title: Correlation and causality | Statistical studies | Probability and Statistics
videos.matches: It explains why two things that happen together do not prove that one causes the other.

videos.title: Introduction to experimental design | High school biology
videos.matches: It explains variables and control groups, the way to rule out a hidden third thing.

videos.title: Microscope invention | The World of Microorganisms | Class 8 | Life Science | Telangana
videos.matches: It tells how the microscope was invented, the tool behind the water-drop lens the lesson asks children to make.

videos.title: Photoreceptors (rods vs cones) | Science | Khan Academy (IN accent)
videos.matches: It explains the rod and cone cells that let the eye see in dim light, as the dark-adaptation test shows.

videos.title: Human eye - features and functions | The human eye and the colourful world
videos.matches: It explains the parts of the eye, including the pupil that changes size as the lesson asks children to watch.

videos.title: Magnetic forces
videos.matches: Covers magnetic force as a pull that acts at a distance, the idea behind a magnet pulling a nail.

videos.title: Magnetic force
videos.matches: Covers the pull and push between magnets and iron, the basic forces the lesson tests with the raft and the nails.

videos.title: Newton's third law
videos.matches: Covers Newton's third law, that a pull works both ways, the idea behind the magnet and the nail pulling each other.

videos.title: Effect of a magnet across a metal plate
videos.matches: Shows a magnet moved over a metal plate affecting the metal, the effect that makes the aluminium can roll.

videos.title: Magnetic effect on Non-Magnetic Materials
videos.matches: Shows that a magnet still has an effect on some materials that are not magnetic, the difference the lesson tests.

videos.title: Speed and Average Speed
videos.matches: Teaches speed as distance divided by time and average speed, the toy-car measurement the lesson does.

videos.title: Units of Speed
videos.matches: Works through units of speed such as metres per second, the unit the toy-car result is written in.

videos.title: Reference frames
videos.matches: Explains that a speed is measured against something else, the idea that one mover has many speeds.

videos.title: Introduction to plate tectonics
videos.matches: Introduces the broken outer shell of the Earth and how its plates move, the base for the lesson's moving ground.

videos.title: Volcanoes
videos.matches: Introduces volcanoes and the melted rock that comes out of them, the lava and magma in the lesson.

videos.title: Earthquakes - Causes and Effects
videos.matches: Covers what causes earthquakes and what they do, the stick, stretch and slip the lesson describes.

videos.title: What Makes Earth Suitable for life
videos.matches: Explains the conditions that let life live on Earth, the test the lesson uses to ask what life needs on other worlds.

videos.title: Earth as the planet for life
videos.matches: Explains why Earth suits life compared with other planets, the habitable-world idea the lesson builds on.

videos.title: Phase changes
videos.matches: Explains melting, freezing and other phase changes using particles, the core idea of the lesson.

videos.title: States of matter
videos.matches: Shows the three states of matter and how particles move in each, the particle picture the lesson uses.

videos.title: Thermal energy and heat transfer
videos.matches: Explains heat moving into a substance, the reason a melting solid takes in heat without getting warmer.
